definition: Choice between an amount with or without the currency.

AmountWithCurrency.name: Amount With Currency
AmountWithCurrency.definition: Number of monetary units specified in a currency where the unit of currency is explicit.

AmountWithoutCurrency.name: Amount Without Currency
AmountWithoutCurrency.definition: Number of monetary units specified in a currency where the unit of currency is implied by the context.
